title: Glucose-Stimulated Glucagon Secretion using Biorep Perifusion Machine - Mouse Islets
author: Aliya F Spigelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u6veze6
materials: Acid Ethanol for islet content collection

steps.title: Isolate mouse islets
steps.instruction: Isolate mouse pancreatic islets following the Mouse Islet Isolation protocol.

steps.title: Prepare culture media
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL RPMI (11.1 mM glucose) (Gibco 1875‑119), add 50 mL FBS (Canadian Origin, Gibco 12483‑020) and 5 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin (Gibco 15140‑122) to make Mouse Islet Culture Media with >90 % islet purity.

steps.title: Pick islets into media
steps.instruction: Pick the isolated mouse islets into the prepared Mouse Islet Culture Media.

steps.title: Overnight islet culture
steps.instruction: Place up to 250 islets in 2 mL of media in a 35 mm culture dish and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare KRBH buffer
steps.instruction: For 100 mL final volume, combine: 7 mL 2 M NaCl (140 mM final), 360 µL 1 M KCl (3.6 mM), 260 µL 1 M CaCl₂ (2.6 mM), 50 µL 1 M NaH₂PO₄ (0.5 mM), 50 µL 1 M MgSO₄ (0.5 mM), 500 µL 1 M HEPES (5 mM), 0.0168 g NaHCO₃ (2 mM), and 50 mg essentially fatty‑acid‑free BSA (0.5 mg/mL). Warm the solution to 37 °C for 30 min–1 h, then adjust pH to 7.45 with NaOH.

steps.title: Add glucose/treatments
steps.instruction: Add the desired concentration of glucose and any additional experimental treatments to the warmed KRBH buffer.

steps.title: Set up perifusion system
steps.instruction: Assemble the chambers and connect the Biorep perifusion machine according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Load islets into chambers
steps.instruction: Place the cultured islets (number per chamber as appropriate for ELISA sensitivity) into each perifusion chamber.

steps.title: Configure perifusion protocol
steps.instruction: Program the perifusion run with a flow rate of 100 µL/min, set step 1 (pre‑incubation) to 30 min, define collection frequency and replicate layout (replicates vary with lane number and plate orientation); the pre‑incubation perfusate will be discarded.

steps.title: Run pre‑incubation
steps.instruction: Run the 30‑min pre‑incubation with the prepared buffer and discard the collected perfusate.

steps.title: Run experimental perifusion
steps.instruction: Continue the perifusion according to the programmed steps, collecting perfusate into clean deep‑well plates (one plate per collection interval).

steps.title: Harvest islets post‑perifusion
steps.instruction: Dry the chambers so that islets remain on the filter paper without liquid, then transfer the filter paper with islets into a 1.5 mL tube containing 500 µL acid ethanol.

steps.title: Store samples
steps.instruction: Store both perfusate and islet‑content samples at –20 °C until ELISA analysis.

steps.title: Assay glucagon
steps.instruction: Thaw perfusate samples, vortex, dilute 1:200, and measure glucagon using MSD glucagon ELISA kits.

steps.title: Optional insulin assay
steps.instruction: If desired, vortex islet content samples, dilute 1:1000, and measure insulin using Alpco Stellux mouse insulin ELISA kits.
